title: Nigeria confirms Ebola case linked to East Africa
text: Nigeria confirmed an Ebola case in a woman who travelled from Uganda to Abuja. The diagnosis was confirmed by laboratory tests. The patient was isolated and received medical care. Authorities identified 44 close contacts and began contact tracing.

title: Ebola has spread from Congo to 4 other countries. A look at where things stand
text: The outbreak began in the Democratic Republic of Congo and spread to other countries. Nigeria reported a case involving a woman who travelled from Uganda. Uganda reported no active cases, while Kenya reported nine cases linked to one patient. France also recorded a case involving a doctor returning from Congo. The outbreak raised concerns about surveillance and cross-border transmission.

title: Nigeria reports Ebola case, fourth African country affected by outbreak
text: Nigeria reported its first Ebola case in more than a decade. Authorities identified 44 contacts and began tracing them. The delayed diagnosis raised concerns about possible exposure. Officials emphasized surveillance and regional coordination. Uganda reported no active cases, while Kenya reported nine cases linked to one patient.
